attributes.additional_details: Britain is facing serious challenges: rising living costs, pressure on the NHS, housing shortages, crime and illegal migration\. People deserve to know their concerns are being heard\. This is not about division—it is about accountability, secure borders and effective leadership\. The time has come to give the British people a voice\. Let us have a General Election and let the people decide Britain’s future\.
attributes.background: A CALL FOR A GENERAL ELECTION.. let the British people decide
